description:
Report how far a submitted simulation job has got.
Inputs: jobId, as submit_simulation or a simulate_* tool returned it.
Example: {"jobId":"0b7c6f3e-5d1a-4c2e-9f8a-2a4e6b1d9c07"}
Returns: status, progress from 0 to 1, stage, queue position, start and finish times, whether a result is ready, when the job expires, the result page URL, and for a failed job the error and its kind.
Poll this rather than holding a call open; it spends nothing.
name: get_simulation_status
title: Get Simulation Status
